patterns.note: The site predominantly uses a dark, immersive background with full-bleed imagery and video sections, creating a premium and focused visual experience.
Horizontal scrolling carousels are integrated within vertical sections to showcase multiple product variations, testimonials, or features without excessive vertical space.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings are used for primary section titles, creating strong visual hierarchy and impact, contrasted with smaller, highly legible body text.
A high-contrast dark theme dominates, featuring deep blacks and dark grays for backgrounds, crisp white text, and vibrant accent colors (blue, green) for calls to action and interactive elements.
The primary navigation bar transforms from a full-height header to a more compact, sticky version with a solid black backdrop as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections and key elements are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video or large image that scrolls at a slower rate than the overlaying text, creating a subtle parallax depth effect as the user scrolls down.

The main navigation bar is initially part of a larger header, then shrinks in height and becomes fixed to the top of the viewport with a solid background after the user scrolls past the initial hero content.

Sections and individual content blocks are animated to appear with a gentle fade-in and slight upward translation as they become visible in the viewport, often with a staggered delay for elements within the section, utilizing css-keyframes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, modern sans-serif headings (up to ~4-5x body text) with generous line height, complemented by smaller, highly legible body text and compact uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (2-4px) on buttons, cards, and input fields, maintaining a clean, modern aesthetic without being overly soft.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, but tighter spacing in content grids and lists.

standout: The site's standout feature is its immersive, dark-themed aesthetic combined with a strong emphasis on product visualization and subtle, engaging scroll-triggered animations. The use of full-bleed video heroes, horizontal scrolling content, and a high-contrast palette creates a premium, editorial feel that effectively showcases the technology and lifestyle associated with the product.
